description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Extends class, which is part of the Smarty template engine. It handles the compilation of the {extends} tag used for template inheritance, including methods for processing, including subtemplates, and generating source code for template inheritance structures.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Extends
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling {extends} tags in Smarty templates, enabling template inheritance.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main method that compiles the {extends} tag, processing attributes and generating appropriate inheritance code.

methods.name: compileEndChild
methods.description: Adds code to mark the end of an inheritance block, ending child templates.

methods.name: compileInclude
methods.description: Includes subtemplate code for inheritance purposes.

methods.name: extendsSourceArrayCode
methods.description: Generates PHP code representing the source of the {extends} tag based on template components.
